question: Can the existing Rust kernel execute a typed .adva program and retain its result, history, certificates and bounded refusal evidence before Python orchestration?
level: native engineering adapter; no new stable calculus
arithmetic: PSC0 Real IEEE-754 f64 scalar realization, not exact rational proofs
objects: one strict embedded source module, selected entry, input map and AST admission fuel
quantifier: two declared positive inputs and targeted rejection/replay cases; no universality claim
checks: existing Rust compilation and evaluation certificates
output files cannot replace input or prior evidence
protected_obligations: source and occurrence identity remain compiler owned
no f64 result becomes an exact arithmetic theorem
free and self-interpretation remain separate obligations
cost_policy: Record phase timings before serialization plus external process wall/RSS. Separate serialization, filesystem publication, total engineering time and a hard in-process wall deadline are not measured; no report byte size is presented as peak memory.
stop: after one bounded validation or one necessary implementation correction; preserve remaining failures
